messages:
alex: RFC follow-up: proposing a small "KV-sensitivity sweep" as a mid-weight onboarding lane. Goal: find models that produce brittle KV/cache behavior without running full benches.

maria: short version: cheaper than deep-bench, more targeted than fast-smoke. curious how you score "sensitivity".

alex: score = weighted combination of relative-latency, kv-miss-delta, and tail-p95 shift vs canonical. Normalize to [0,1]. High score = sensitive.

kevin: what budget and sample plan? ops will ask for hard caps.

alex: target ~100-300 seq, cap tokens per-run (default 120k). Two sampling pools: fixed golden seeds (40%) + live reservoir (60%). Reservoir is tenant-aware and skips PII.

maria: gating rule idea: if kv_sens > 0.6 -> block auto-deploy and require deep-regress. If 0.4-0.6 -> warn + canary with 1% traffic. <0.4 -> pass. Make thresholds configurable per-tenant.

tom: quant variants? run sweep on FP32 canonical + default quant. Extra quant uploads run a delta-sweep (20 seq) and compute delta_sens. If delta_sens > 0.2 -> gate.

alex: intake should emit a compact fingerprint: kv_sens_vector = [sens_score, rel_latency, miss_delta]. Flat JSON in metadata so runtime can route. Example: {artifact:1234, lane:sweep, outcome:WARN, kv_sens_vector:[0.52,1.18,0.03], sample_tag:seed-2026-03}.

kevin: sketch intake lane YAML so infra can enforce budgets: ```yaml
lanes:
  fast-smoke:
    budget_tokens: 5000
  kv-sensitivity-sweep:
    budget_tokens: 120000
    sample_size: 200
  deep-bench:
    budget_tokens: 4_000_000
```

maria: rollout: feature-flagged per-org, start opt-in. Canary 1% for 48h when score in warn band. Retain full traces 14d, compact vectors 2y.

onboard-bot: Ticket created ML-ONB-6111 "KV-sensitivity sweep lane" (assignee: alex).

kevin: next steps: alex drafts short spec + pass thresholds, i'll add intake enforcement, tom will add quant-delta check. Sync Thurs 9am. :thumbsup:
